ICS 206 WF rebuilt as a real per-incident editable form (commit 930e82a, merged to main). Audited the shipped schema against the actual NWCG form + completion instructions: old shape was modeled on the research doc summary table and was missing ALL phone numbers (blocks 3/4/5 each require one), hospital VHF, and both Area Location Capability (block 6) + Remote Camp Locations (block 7); it also carried a medical-aid-stations block that does not exist on the WF variant. Now all 7 blocks + signature block as an autosaving accordion, all-string values (paper form is free text), tri-state Yes/No so an unchecked box is not silently No. Data is incident-scoped: one doc per incident keyed by local incident number (Black Canyon 08/13/2026 -> 26BC0813001), index + active-incident pointer, same storage keys on web and mobile. Burn calculator now reads burn centers from the active incident instead of a bundled constant. Also pulled + pinned ICS 220 WF (03/25, block 12 Extraction/Medevac) and ICS 204 WF (08/25, CUI//Basic) for the next build. Verified in Chrome end-to-end: created incident, number rendered 26BC0813001, typed into block 3, chip reached SAVED, reload survived IndexedDB round-trip, practice incident shows fictional banner. Root suite green, web+mobile tsc clean, expo export green. NOT yet done: QR/IAP scan ingestion (blocked on knowing what the QR payload decodes to), ICS 204/220 screens, mobile EAS republish.

MIR rebuilt against the owner-photographed ICS-206 WF (03/18) Appendix C (commit 4217590, merged to main, EAS group e7d9daf4). Owner flagged the form did not match; confirmed: sections 7/8 were medical-emergency-channel + prepared-by where the form has CONTINGENCY + ADDITIONAL INFORMATION, section 2 fields (evac request / patient location / patient care) were split across 3 screens, section 3 was a single vitals box where the form repeats per patient most-severe-first, section 6 was 2 loose freq fields where the form is a COMMAND/AIR-TO-GRND/TACTICAL table with RX/TX/tone-NAC. Page 1 (Medical Plan blocks 1-7) was already correct for this revision - unchanged. Legacy saved reports migrated field-by-field; preparer name/position has no cell on the MIR page so it is appended to Additional Information rather than dropped. NEW: sharing via email/SMS on both MIR and ICS 206, gated behind an explicit authorized-recipient acknowledgement (verified no mailto:/sms: link exists in the DOM until accepted); app sends nothing itself and names no recipient - hands a prefilled draft to the device mail/messaging app; all shared text wrapped in CUI//Basic markings; practice-incident shares state FICTIONAL in the body. Enabled allowImportingTsExtensions in both app tsconfigs so shared internal imports carry the .ts extension node ESM requires (webpack/Metro/tsc all accept). Verified: 21 new shared tests, Chrome walkthrough to section 7 + script + share gate, no console errors, root suite green, both tsc clean, expo export green. NOT yet confirmed on a handset. (2) DAY MODE: dark-only is now dark-by-default; toggle lives in the header on every screen. Mobile got a palette context; ALL 13 screens/components converted, no screen left pinned to night. Light ramp is the dark one inverted so tokens keep meaning; ember + triage darkened for contrast (night yellow on white would make a PRIORITY 2 unreadable). Tap-start/tap-stop, playback, delete; notes sit beside the written cell, never replace it; mirToText states how many notes exist and that they stayed on the device since audio cannot ride a text share. Owner feedback round 2 (commit 4a730b8, EAS group e4aa54b1, channel verified serving it). (1) PATIENT COUNT + TABS: section 2 gets a patient-count stepper (the form own section 2 example says including number of patients so this is faithful); section 3 becomes PT 1/PT 2/PT 3 tabs colour-coded by per-patient severity, adjustable any direction. Per-patient severity is an ADDITION to the paper form - printed 206 WF has one incident-level severity in section 2 then says start with the most severe patient without giving a per-patient cell; section 2 priority left untouched. Unset severity renders neutral not green (not-assessed != minor). Stepper REFUSES to drop a patient with anything recorded and reports how many it kept. (2) AUDIO PAUSE added w/ running position + restart; replaying a finished note seeks to 0 first.
